Hindi Concept: यद कसी बहुपद (p(x)) को (x-a) से वभािजत कया जाता है, तो शषे फल (p(a)) होता है। Factor Theorem If: p(a) = 0 then: x - a is a factor of (p(x)). Hindi Concept: यद (p(a)=0), तो (x-a), बहुपद (p(x)) का एक गणु नखडं होगा। Factorization of Quadratic Polynomial Standard form: ax² + bx + c The curriculum includes factorization by splitting the middle term. Example form: ax² + bx + c The middle term (bx) is split into two suitable terms so that grouping can be applied. Hindi Term: पणू वग बनाकर हल करना Quadratic Formula For: ax² + bx + c = 0 the roots are: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a Discriminant The discriminant is: D = b² - 4ac Nature of roots: D > 0 → Two distinct real roots D = 0 → Two equal real roots D < 0 → No real roots Relation Between Roots and Coefficients If the roots are (\alpha) and (\beta): α + β = -b/a αβ = c/a Formation of Quadratic Equation from Roots If the roots are (\alpha) and (\beta), then the equation is: x² - (α + β)x + αβ = 0 Learning Outcomes Students should be able to: ● Identify quadratic equations. ● Find roots using factorization. ● Solve equations by completing the square. ● Apply the quadratic formula. ● Calculate the discriminant. ● Determine the nature of roots. ● Find unknown coefficients. ● verify roots of an equation. ● Form a quadratic equation from given roots.
